extracted.name: Marinade for Steak
extracted.description: This is a great marinade for any cut of beef, from ribeye to skirt steak, that's made with basic pantry ingredients for tender, juicy steak every time.
instruction_lines: Combine oil, soy sauce, vinegar, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, ground black pepper, mustard, onion, and garlic in a medium bowl. Mix together well, and use to marinate your favorite steak.
